links.outcome: LLM performance on five epilepsy tasks with vs without Graph-RAG grounding in the knowledge graph
links.effect: Graph-RAG consistently improved performance across all tasks for six LLMs, with the largest gains in pharmacogenomic reasoning (+30-41%).
links.quote: Results show that integrating \textsc{EpiGraph} consistently improves performance across all tasks, with the largest gains observed in pharmacogenomic reasoning (+30--41\%).

unlisted_practices: Building a domain-specific knowledge graph from peer-reviewed literature to support LLM clinical reasoning

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs on clinical epilepsy reasoning tasks with and without a knowledge-graph retrieval-augmented generation (Graph-RAG) grounding safeguard.
